prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Moving sign-in post-adoption (+13.3%, underpredicted) or post-certificate (+5.8%, overpredicted) was helpful, while placing sign-in after the waiting room made results worse (-3.9%) and hand-off timing showed no clear effect.
Multi-device account sync banners were helpful (+2.7%, overpredicted), but pet sync verification hints and pet restoration callouts showed no clear effect.
Path clarity headline updates were helpful (+5.9%, underpredicted), whereas copy simplification, value refreshes, clear outcome headlines, value focus refreshes, and time expectation banners showed no clear effect.
Interactive waiting rooms (+5.6%, overpredicted) and background hatching readiness status (+3.3%, underpredicted) were helpful, but 3D progress trackers, progress details, animation progress status, sound notifications, and spawn alerts showed no clear effect.
Photo quality guides with companion preview were helpful (+7.6%, overpredicted), while compact grid layouts (-7.7%), photo fallback flows (-11.8%), and custom photo guidelines banners (-5.0%) made results worse; split upload assistants showed no clear effect.
System tray location notification tips were helpful (+3.8%, overpredicted), whereas first interaction tips made results worse (-6.5%), and sound notifications, spawn alerts, mascot welcome stages, interaction badges, and tray controls tips showed no clear effect.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Account Ownership Continuity Callout: Display a targeted account continuity hint on the sign in screen explaining that adopted pets are permanently saved to your cloud profile. (why: 8 support emails mentioned pets missing or reset after signing in again, indicating confusion around account linking.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Certificate Mascot Stamp Redesign: Redesign the adoption certificate screen into a stage layout with an animated pet mascot preview and official registration badge. (why: Adoption is the biggest drop-off point in the onboarding funnel with only 63.0% completion and long median duration (89s).)
2: [finish, new_screen] Pet Care & Floating Window Overview Screen: Insert a dedicated desktop behavior screen (new_pet_care_overview) right before finishing onboarding detailing how the floating window remains visible on screen. (why: 3 support emails reported pets not appearing on desktop and 3 users were confused about how to control or hide the companion.)
3: [adoption, new_flow] Pre-Hatching Companion Trait Builder Flow: Add an interactive audio sound preview and trait selector step during the pet selection screen. (why: 3 support emails noted custom pet creation failures or unexpected pet appearance during adoption.)
4: [sign_in, reorder] Sign-In Before Adoption Handoff Reorder: Move sign-in directly after path selection and before pet adoption so account state is secured before companion generation. (why: 8 emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in later, while sign_in step has high completion rate (90.9%).)
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Visibility Status Check Wait Info: Display a desktop window status check notice and time estimate on the waiting screen while background assets render. (why: The waiting screen (home step) has a long median duration of 201s and 3 users reported desktop pet rendering failures.)
6: [choose_path, layout] Story Welcome Card Showcase Layout: Switch the intro story screen layout to a structured card view with step counter indicators. (why: choose_path drops 21% of users right at the beginning of onboarding with a mean time of 514s.)
7: [finish, hint] Desktop Docking Hint on Welcome Screen: Add a prominent system tray shortcut hint to the home intro screen explaining quick pet commands. (why: 3 support tickets reported post-onboarding confusion on how to hide, show, or control the pet.)
8: [adoption, notification] Custom Photo Quality Assurance Banner: Add a real-time photo clarity guidance badge inside the photo upload screen. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or distorted custom pet renders.)
